title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Lentil Soup
description: This crock pot chicken and lentil soup is simmered in the slow cooker with tomatoes, onion, green lentils, and spices for a no-fuss cold-weather meal.
ingredients: 1 pound green lentils, sorted and rinsed
0.5 teaspoon salt, or more to taste
1.5 pounds bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs, or more to taste

steps.text: Combine green lentils, tomatoes, onion, minced garlic, cumin, oregano, chili powder, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and salt in a slow cooker. Pour in chicken broth and stir gently to evenly distribute seasonings. Settle chicken thighs into broth, ensuring they are submerged in liquid.
Cook on High for 4 hours. Chicken should be falling off the bone and lentils should be tender (if not, cook a little bit longer).

Use tongs to remove chicken from soup to a cutting board. Pull meat off the bones with tongs and either rough chop or break apart into bite-sized pieces; discard the bones. Stir meat into soup and adjust seasonings as desired.
